# Text entry

Which of the two multi-line surfaces you want depends on what the document
*is*. `UltraCanvasTextArea` edits **text** — plain, syntax-highlighted, or
Markdown rendered live with the caret line showing its source; formatting is a
function of the characters in the buffer, so what Markdown cannot spell cannot
be typed. `UltraCanvasRichTextEdit` edits a **`UCRichDocument`** — the model the
ODT/DOCX/DOC readers and writers already produce — so bold is a state of the
selection, and fonts, sizes, colours and alignment survive a round trip through
`.odt` or `.docx`. Source files, logs and Markdown belong in the TextArea; word
-processing documents belong in the RichTextEdit.

`UltraCanvasTextInput` covers what a text field is expected to do: caret,
click-to-position, drag selection, Home/End/arrows, Delete, cut/copy/paste,
undo/redo, placeholder, max length, validation state, horizontal scrolling and
multi-byte text. Reproducing even half of that by hand is a week of bugs.

Password fields also get a reveal control: an eye button inside the field, on
by default (`SetShowPasswordToggle(false)` removes it), and `SetPasswordRevealed()` drives the same state
from an external "Show password" checkbox. See
[UltraCanvasTextInputExamples.md](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTextInputExamples.md).

## Elements

| Element | What it is for | Callbacks |
|---|---|---|
| `UltraCanvasAutoComplete` | Text with a suggestion list | - |
| [`UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator`](../Elements/UltraCanvasDocumentNavigator.md) | A **document navigator** beside an `UltraCanvasRichTextEdit` — the headings as a tree that follows the caret (promote, demote, move or drag a chapter), tables, pictures, charts, comments with their authors, bookmarks, … | `onCommentActivated`, `onEntryActivated` (+8 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasPasswordRuleLegend`](../Elements/UltraCanvasPasswordRuleLegend.md) | Password quality feedback | `AddRule`, `onAllRulesMet`, `onRuleStatusChanged` (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter`](../Elements/UltraCanvasPasswordStrengthMeter.md) | Password quality feedback | `onStrengthChanged`, `onStrengthLevelChanged` (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasRichTextEdit`](../Elements/UltraCanvasRichTextEdit.md) | A **formatted document** edited as it looks — fonts, sizes, colours, headings, lists, tables, images | `onHeaderFooterEditingChanged`, `AddDocumentObserver`, `onZoomChanged`, `onDocumentChanged`, `onSelectionChanged`, `onLinkClicked`, `onCommentActivated`, `onFontLinkClicked` … (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasSpinner`](../Elements/UltraCanvasSpinner.md) | A number with up/down steppers | `SetFormatter`, `onValueChanged`, `onValueChanging`, `onSelectionChanged`, `onEditingFinished`, `onStepsFinished` (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasTagInput`](../Elements/UltraCanvasTagInput.md) | Tokens / tags typed into a field | `onTagsChanged`, `onTagAdded`, `onTagRemoved`, `validator` (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasTextArea`](../Elements/UltraCanvasTextArea.md) | Multi-line text or code | `onLineEndingChanged`, `onTextChanged`, `onCursorPositionChanged`, `onSelectionChanged`, `onContextMenu`, `onBeforeKeyDown`, `onFocusGained`, `onFocusLost` … (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasTextFormatBar`](../Elements/UltraCanvasTextFormatBar.md) | The **text formatting bar** over text the user sets — Font (every installed family, each shown in itself), Size, Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough, alignment, line and letter spacing; reports each change, helpers … | `onFormatChanged`, `onControlDone` (+8 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasTextInput`](../Elements/UltraCanvasTextInput.md) | Single-line text | `onTextChanged`, `onSelectionChanged`, `onValidationChanged`, `onEnterPressed`, `onEscapePressed`, `onFocusGained`, `onFocusLost`, `onCleared` … (+5 inherited) |
